actual_boolean_family: F*(x,y)=(b(x)-2*1_(x=0))y_(Mx), b(x)=(-1)^q(x), q(0)=0 quadratic over F2
parameter_domain: n=1..3: every quadratic q modulo constant, every a=0..2 binary address matrix. n=4: every quadratic q, eight address maps [],[1],[15],[1,2],[3,12],[5,10],[15,15],[7,14]. n=5,6: four zero-linear quadratic graphs (matching,path,star,complete), every coordinate-projection address subset, and three oblique maps [allones],[oddmask,evenmask],[allones,allones]. At n=4,5,6 add the same four zero-linear graphs/all projection subsets/three oblique maps as explicit tree cases. Cases duplicated by this frozen union are counted separately. For boundary/asymptotic ledgers use the matching graph on n=2,4,6 and every prefix r=0..n.
case_count: Case count calculated and saved before the first Walsh check; no adaptive domain changes. Approximately 14000 root cases plus under 600 stopping trees.
symmetry: Global sign omitted by q(0)=0; no further symmetry quotient
arithmetic: Integer Walsh transforms of control-only signed indicators; exact Fraction probabilities/influences/pair incidences/derivative charges; entropy and erasure as rational linear forms in log2 integers with exact rational atanh-series interval bounds (proved tails). Independent physical edge and 2-face derivative checks averaged over the named data signs.
memory_estimate: Under 50 MB. Per case at most 64 control assignments, 64 terminal labels and 4096 singleton-data Fourier entries. Physical dimension n+2^a may be 70; no physical full-cube enumeration occurs. No job over 300 MB.
validation_targets: zero bad-node boundary charge in specified stopping trees
